annotations.text:
Post in order, one per day. Each is 1080x1920.

01 - Something exists, you are not saying what. The redaction is the signature device.
02 - AOV / CAC / LTV. An audience filter, not a description: operators recognise all three, nobody else does. Never says ecommerce.
03 - A tension they already feel, with the answer redacted. Curiosity about their own business, not about a name.

The 01 / 03 counter is the retention mechanic - it tells people more is coming and gives them a reason to check back.

The empty band above each CTA is deliberate: drop a poll or question sticker there. Story replies land in DMs, which is the engagement that counts.

Top and bottom 250px stay clear for Instagram's profile row and reply bar.
